messages:
emily: Quick check before anyone SSHs — I'm about to investigate gpu-prod-12 (us-west2). Can we confirm the safe steps for live debugging? Need to pull logs briefly. (incident PD#7421)

oncall-bot: Reminder: request temporary access via PAM before SSH. Link: https://okta.example/privileged-access :lock:

ryan: can we just scp logs to my laptop and scrub locally? faster.

emily: please don't copy raw logs to personal devices. Use the bastion and scrub there, then push a redacted artifact to S3/artifacts with limited TTL. Example redaction commands to run on the bastion:
```bash
# mask api keys and tokens
sed -E 's/(api_key|access_token)=\\S+/\\1=[REDACTED]/g' /var/log/app.log > /tmp/app.log.redacted
# remove emails
perl -pe 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[EMAIL_REDACTED]/g' /tmp/app.log.redacted > /tmp/app.log.redacted2
```

chris: ok. If I need sudo/root to read the file, request ephemeral sudo via PAM ticket? who approves?

emily: request via Ops -> Privileged Access with duration=1h, approver group = security-oncall. Put reason: 'prod investigation PD#7421'. Approvals usually ~10m on weekdays. Enable session recording if available.

security: quick policy note — avoid copying IPs to public tickets. If you must include an IP, obfuscate the last octet (e.g., 10.2.3.x). Strip any user tokens. If you produce an S3 artifact, set kms=redwood-prod, ttl=24h, and attach the link in the private ticket only.

ryan: what's the allowed way to capture a stack trace snippet? full trace okay?

emily: include only the stack lines with function names and a short context, not full heap dumps or query param values. If the trace contains PII, redact before sharing. Quick python scrubber example:
```python
import re,sys
s=sys.stdin.read()
print(re.sub(r"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}","[UUID]", re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}","[EMAIL]", s)))
```

chris: noted. I'll request PAM now and run redaction on the bastion, then upload to artifacts with ttl. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Access request 12948 submitted, approver: security-oncall. ETA approval ~8m.

emily: thanks — I'll monitor PD and keep the runbook open: https://runbook.internal/runbooks/prod-debug-security. If anything unusual, ping security directly.

security: good plan. Also add a short audit note in the ticket listing the commands you ran (no raw outputs).

ryan: ack. updating ticket.
